interfaces.summary: PersistenceCoordinator/write-behind/preparations removed; handle-based session storage contract added.

SessionPersistenceCreateOptions/OpenOptions/ListOptions/StatOptions added; resume is now an explicit open with access mode.
Cross-process kernel write lease: SessionWriteLease via flock(2) on session.lock (POSIX) / named semaphore (Windows); SessionAlreadyOwnedError.

interfaces.summary: Handle-based native session resume: a NEW runtime generation opens the SAME persisted DSH session through SessionPersistence.open(id, 'read'|'write') and reads/appends its contiguous log. SessionHandle.flush is the only durability barrier; SessionWriteLease (flock) fences concurrent writers and the kernel releases it on process death; readColdSessionLog reads a cold log without ownership. Qualified against every Runtime Continuity failure-matrix row.
evidence: docs/evidence/d15/d15-3/native-resume-results.v1.json: 8/8 persisted failure rows natively resumed with the same session id, preserved event log and contiguous sequence; a lost run is truthfully interrupted; an unmaterialized session is correctly not resumable and requires BYQ fallback
